have been failed by this practice repeatedly over the years - even prior to the pandemic. Most notable though was me asking for help about leg pain and a numb foot. I was told I was fine, or to “just take paracetamol” despite calling after months of worsening. A year later, I ended up hospitalised for 10 days after being temporarily paralysed from the neck down- long story short I needed spinal surgery ( had to go private= £10000)
I was 19 at the time and they told me I was “too young” to have anything wrong. That year was agony. I couldn’t even stand up straight for more than 5 mins, every time I asked for help I was denied and not once seen in person. To this day I can’t feel the back of my right leg due to nerve damage - and that won’t change. All of this was so avoidable if they had just listened to me.

Im sad to say that I have lost all faith in this practice. I’m 22 and the amount of times I have been ignored is disgusting.
